output.summary: Evidence does not show ITS deprioritising Arts. SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts volume, all routed to P4 best-effort under RR-17) explain about 70% of the 6-day resolution gap. Matched non-SlotBook Arts tickets are within 0.3 days of other faculties. Remaining delay comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only Lindqvist on-site coverage. Duplicate and how-to rates are normal, so trivial tickets do not drive volume. Non-SlotBook volume is still 1.6x average, so SlotBook does not fully explain it. The P4 acknowledgement hides best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished: the 2025-08-12 meeting has no record. Fix support status and acknowledgements and report split metrics. Do not move the desk budget or decommission SlotBook yet.
